questions.q: What do you do with the Raspberry Pi UART before connecting the FC?
options: Take the console off the port
questions.explain: Take the Linux console off the port (raspi-config) and enable the hardware port; otherwise the console holds it.
Normal for short wires; for long ones, 57 (57600).
mavlink-router or mavp2p hands the stream out over UDP/TCP.

questions.q: Why run the script as a systemd service?
questions.explain: A script started from SSH dies with the session.

questions.q: The Pi shut down in flight; the FC has its own telemetry radio to the GCS. What happens to the FC?
options: It goes to RTL after a timeout
questions.explain: The FC keeps working; when the Pi powers back up, the service starts by itself.

questions.q: Why disable Bluetooth for the UART on a Pi 4?
questions.explain: Bluetooth takes the full UART, and the mini UART is unstable at 921600: dtoverlay=disable-bt.

questions.q: How do scripts connect when mavlink-router is used?
options: Through an SSH tunnel to the port
questions.explain: Otherwise they get in each other's way.

options: Undervoltage and throttling occurred since boot
questions.explain: Bits 16 and 18: undervoltage and throttling have occurred; bits 0–3 mean it is happening now.
